messages:
Micah: Heads up — deploybot scheduled runtime + API + router pin at 02:00 UTC in the late window. rolling shared-config v12 -> v13. Can ops/console folks confirm console is green?

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by Micah for 2050123456. Services: runtime, api, router, console. Rollout mode: staggered 5% -> 50% -> 100%. Canary window: 15m. Pins: console->v2.3.1, api->v1.8.0, runtime->v4.0-q.

Jess: console had a small spike yesterday at 23:30, but we merged the retry-loop mitigation — v2.3.1 includes the fix, right?

Rami: yes v2.3.1 includes the retry fix and the client header change. Router needs passthrough for the new header key. Router team, you good?

Olivia: Router team here — header passthrough is live in prod canary (deployed earlier). :thumbsup:

Micah: Plan: run a tiny canary (5%) for 10m, monitor 5xx rate, p50/p95 latency, and console error count. Hold and rollback if 5xx > 1.5x baseline OR p50 > baseline*1.4 for >3m. Also flip console sampling to 100% for 1m during the window.

ops-sre: I'll add a temporary alert rule: name=late-window-deploy-2050123456. Trigger if 5xx_rate >1.5x OR p50>1.4*baseline sustained for 3m. Adding extra capacity cushion to the shard pools.

Jess: Also want a soft-fallback route in router to route to runtime-legacy if errors spike. deploy-bot — how do we wire fallback?

deploy-bot: Fallback policy exists. Add label fallback=true to the canary group. Example:
```
deploybot set-policy --thread 2050123456 --fallback-group runtime-legacy --threshold 1.5
```

Rami: Good. Also we should add a short release-note blurb for the console schema change so support and CS aren't surprised. I'll draft it.

Micah: Draft RN: "Shared config v13: router header passthrough enabled; client retry semantics normalized; temporary increased console sampling during rollout." Keep it concise.

Olivia: One more: Dedicated eu-west uses an older runtime image; exclude the dedicated-eu pool from this pin for now.

Micah: Ack — exclude dedicated-eu in deploybot config.

Jess: If we need to hold: rollback plan = immediate traffic shift to previous pinned versions (deploy-bot rollback --to <previous>), notify #incidents, escalate to SRE on-call if >5m.

ops-sre: I'll paste the quick rollback runbook into the ops runbooks repo and attach here: steps 1) pause rollout, 2) shift traffic to pinned, 3) confirm health, 4) roll forward fix branch, 5) postmortem tag.

deploy-bot: Canary starting 2050123490 — 5% traffic. Monitoring gates open.

Jess: seeing +2% p50, 5xx stable. continuing.

Micah: 2050123540 — canary at 50% now, no alerts. proceeding to full.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete 2050123580 — rollout reached 100%. No trigger alerts fired. Tagging release notes draft: repo://releases/2050123456/rn.md :tada:

Rami: leaving the console sampling flag in diff for 1h just to be safe.

Olivia: will follow up with dedicated-eu upgrade ticket.

Micah: nice work team. will close the deploy thread once release note and runbook links are attached.
